steps.prompt: $247$ pupils share $6$ buses equally. About how many on each bus? Which number is easy to divide by $6$?

cards.title: Compatible numbers
cards.body: For division, round to a number that is in the times table. $247 \div 6$: $240$ is $6 \times 40$, so $247 \div 6 \approx 40$. These friendly numbers are called compatible numbers.

steps.text: Look for a multiple of $9$ near $362$: $36$ is $9 \times 4$, so $360 = 9 \times 40$.

cards.title: Rounding up in real life
cards.body: $43$ pupils go on a trip in minibuses of $8$. $43 \div 8$ is $5$ with $3$ left over. Those $3$ pupils still need a bus, so you need $6$ minibuses.

prompts: When do you round a division answer up instead of down?
